create_PanopticDeepLabTargetGenerator: create a PanopticDeepLabTargetGenerator with ignore_label, thing_ids, and sigma parameters for training target generation
generate_training_targets_call: call the PanopticDeepLabTargetGenerator with panoptic array and segments_info to generate semantic segmentation and offset targets
generate_center_heatmap: generate a center heatmap with Gaussian kernel for thing instance centers using the target generator
generate_offset_targets: generate offset targets with y and x direction offsets from instance pixels to their centers
configure_small_instance_weights: configure small instance area threshold and weight to adjust semantic loss for small instances
